title: Unit Event — Same Dreams, Same Colors — Episode2 What Goes Unseen

meta.Event Outline: Kohane and the rest of VBS continue practicing in pursuit of greater growth. However, Toya finds himself struggling to understand the vision that his teammates have for a song due to his lack of life experience. That's when Luka offers some advice!

rows.Line: Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, we've listened to every song that we brought now!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, let's start making our final selections. Or should I say...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The four of you seem to have already come to a decision.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I mean, the way you all reacted to it compared to when you listened to everything else...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, Shiraishi's song does seem to be our favorite option.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree. I really want to try singing that song. It's a little different from what we usually do, but it sounds so hip and cool!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! Awesome!!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
We've reached a consensus.
Let's divvy up parts and give it a go.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Okay.
We'll give it a few more listens and then try it from the top.

rows.Speaker: Kohane & An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Still, I didn't expect to see you here again, Luka. I mean, you're like KAITO when it comes to exploring and wandering around this place...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You all missed me quite a lot, no?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Not really.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, stop!
I know you did♪

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You never change, huh, Luka?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But I'm glad that I came back right as they were picking out a new song. I'm really looking forward to seeing how to practice it from start to finish.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As for my part, I have a feeling this section is going to give me some trouble...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, that was great!
It's definitely a tricky section, but you were pitch-perfect!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I was? Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I have a feeling that this section would sound amazing if we gave it a clearer feel.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A clearer feel...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I just happened to practice a song like this when I was working with Taiga...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: The way it was sung was so pure and beautiful.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What do mean by that?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I mean... How do I describe that...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I know!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: It was like I was in the middle of a serene forest, I think...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: A forest...?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. You can hear birds chirping or leaves rustling when you're in a forest, right? But at the same time, it's such a quiet and peaceful place.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: So I have a feeling that this song will sound just as nice if we can give it that kind of feel...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get what you're trying to say!
There's plenty of beauty within that serenity.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay, I have a better understanding now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Really...?!
Thank goodness.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also, it's amazing that you've learned how to express yourself like this, Kohane. You've grown so much!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, my guess is that Taiga had her listen to a wide variety of music to draw these feelings out from within her.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: At the same time, your suggestion is easier said than done even if we have a better image of what you meant...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah, true.
How can we make that happen...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Sorry, everyone...
It may sound strange for me to say this now...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Is something the matter, Aoyagi...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: But I don't actually know what a forest is like.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've seen them on TV before, but I couldn't tell you what it feels like to be there...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, that's what you meant?
Have you ever gone on one of those field trips to the mountains? You know, when you're supposed to think about what it's like to be surrounded by nature?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: An, wait.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Sorry, I was never allowed to go because of how I wouldn't be able to play the piano or violin if I hurt my hands...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Aside from field trips, I wasn't allowed to participate in other school events, including sports competitions and such.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, that's right...!
You mentioned that before...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I-I'm so sorry, Aoyagi!
I didn't mean to be so inconsiderate...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
It's okay, really.
That's all in the past now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I need to apologize as well...
Not having experienced what you said has turned into a roadblock for us.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: If I had been to a real forest before, I might've been able to understand what you meant when you said, “Quiet and peaceful...”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hey, that's not your fault.
You'll just have to make up for it with your imagination.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I know but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, why don't you just go to one?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: If you've never experienced it before, then why not just go see for yourself? Wouldn't that be the quickest solution?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I mean, using your imagination is great and all, but try describing snow to someone who's never seen snow before. Saying it's “white” or “cold” wouldn't do it much justice, no?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: And I have a feeling these sorts of experiences will help you sing better!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: You have a feeling? That's reassuring...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... But she may have a point.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: How people sing can really vary based on their personal experiences. My dad being a prime example of that.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (Oh, right...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (The way Luka sings must have so much depth to it because she's been to many places and experienced so much...)

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yeah, I'm with Luka on this one.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Me too. I say go and experience as much of the world as you can.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That'd be great if we could...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But you can't find the kind of peaceful and serene forest Kohane was talking about here. It's not exactly easy to go somewhere like that...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (However, Luka's right...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (I was sure that my knowledge would be what I contribute to this team, but that clearly has its limits.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: (This may be a good opportunity to experience something new for a change.)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I agree completely with what Luka said.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I have very little experience with anything other than music, so my hope was that I could use that knowledge to make up for that... But that isn't possible right now.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, for my own self-betterment, as well as our team's growth...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'd like it if we could visit a real forest in the near future.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What...?
